description: Read one topic of the manual in full by its slug (from about or search_library). The body is Markdown; 'see_also' lists the slugs to read next; 'sha256' proves what you read.
name: read_topic

see_also.description: Slugs of the topics to read next.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the body as served, lower-case hex; cite it to prove what you read.

slug.description: The stable identifier of the topic.

status.description: 'draft' or 'published'. A draft has not been reviewed by the operator yet.

summary.description: One or two sentences that answer the question the title asks.

tags.description: Keywords; the first names the group of the topic.

title: Read a topic
